package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for raw_scan_inside_loop: GORM Raw(...).Scan(...) chains observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule287PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario287Positive(db *gorm.DB, ids []int) ([]Rule287PositiveRecord, error) {
	var results []Rule287PositiveRecord
	for _, id := range ids {
		var item Rule287PositiveRecord
		if err := db.Raw("SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE id = ?", id).Scan(&item).Error; err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		results = append(results, item)
	}
	return results, nil
}
